mapper.select: SELECT createTime, createUser, name_ AS name, GROUP_CONCAT( ASSIGNEE_ ) AS assignee FROM ( SELECT a.create_time AS createTime, a.create_user AS createUser, b.name_, b.ASSIGNEE_ FROM ( SELECT process_instance_id, create_user, create_time FROM v_ft_act_business WHERE business_table_name = #{tableName} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROC_INST_ID_, name_, ASSIGNEE_ FROM v_act_ru_task ) b ON a.process_instance_id = b.PROC_INST_ID_ ) c GROUP BY createTime, createUser, name_
